notes.title: Community Update | This War of Mine: Final Cut and Displate Store!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/45c4998ca5d8bf853d0f11f3f03c1425d330131e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi there, Community![/b][/h1]

This is a very exciting (and busy!) week for us at 11 bit studios.

[b]Firstly[/b], we're super proud to announce that our official metal posters store has just launched on Displate! Frostpunk and Moonlighter ones are available right away - but we probably are going to expand the offer in the future! Be sure to let us know what posters you'd like to see in our Displate Store.

Make your apartment prettier than ever before! Get some posters [url=https://displate.com/11bitgaming][b]HERE[/b][/url]! 

And be sure to use a special promo code:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/b5112bc6476b86e6bce5776fe0f63a07ac253411.jpg[/img]

[b]Secondly[/b], we're celebrating the [b]5th Anniversary of This War of Mine[/b] by releasing special edition of the game called Final Cut.

[b]This War of Mine: Final Cut is the conclusive, remastered edition of the game[/b] that contains all the updates and free expansions released so far and introduces not only a new scenario but also expands all scenarios with the locations known from Stories DLCs - even if you don’t own those. In short words - that means you can now experience lots of never-seen-before playthroughs and struggle with new challenges.

[b]Here's the trailer for Final Cut:[/b]
https://youtu.be/SJAdkY1soh4
[b]It's a free update, so if you own the game already - just update it.[/b] But if you would like to buy This War of Mine and experience all the content, old and new, the game is on sale at the moment, so it's a perfect moment to catch up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/282070/This_War_of_Mine/

Have a good one!
[i]11 bit studios[/i]

notes.title: This War of Mine and Frostpunk - now in a BUNDLE! 15% OFF!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/2b6ff148daa9d7cff6690f13653f53850c065086.jpg[/img]

Hi there, everyone!

[h1][b]We're proud to announce that two of our best-selling games are now available in one package![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/a084291486a08a8d4913e696518eafbf0243f48e.jpg[/img]
[b]Frostpunk[/b] - the first society survival game that puts you in a shoes of a ruler of the last city on Earth. Here, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and its infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

And...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30442987/75e9812c9dc36c834330d2d2b178bc54436ebf06.jpg[/img]
[b]This War Of Mine[/b] - an award-winning survival game in which you do not play as an elite soldier, but a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. A trurly unique experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

[h1]Get the bundle [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8650/This_War_of_Mine_and_Frostpunk/][b]HERE[/b][/url], 15% OFF![/h1]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Anomaly Warzone Earth Mobile Campaign
notes.notes:
Anomaly Warzone Earth Mobile Campaign is Now Available on Steam!

Anomaly Warzone Earth Mobile Campaign continues Steam's Anomaly Warzone Earth in extra 15-level campaign. Originally released on mobile devices, the campaign is brought to Steam for PC, Mac and Linux exclusively in Anomaly Bundle.


AWE Mobile Campaign turns tower defense on its head. This time you take control of the attacking force, pitting your heavily armored squad against the destructive towers of an alien horde. Carefully lead your squad through the invaders' defenses, shattering their towers and turrets with special weapons and power-ups in this experience of tower offense.
